messages:
incident-bot: P0 PAGE — potential routing/pin misconfiguration affecting live inference. Symptoms: embeddings endpoint returning long-form generated text for a subset of requests; increased 500s from gen path. Paging ops-oncall.

sara: I’m oncall, taking this. any immediate customer reports? :eyes:

customer-ops: Yep, Support flagged 3 enterprise tenants seeing incorrect payloads in embeddings API (vec length mismatch). Ticket IDs: #ENG-4801, #ENG-4803, #ENG-4807. They report recent deploys but unclear if related.

mike: seeing error spike in /v1/embeddings route in eu-west-1. metrics: 12xx->5xx and content-type changed. quick query: top route keys show alias client-xyz pinned to model variant v2026-instruct.

anjali: wait, instruct -> chat/ gen mismatch is possible when fallback routing picks a chat-compatible runtime. grabbing routing config now.

jordan: copy — run `routingctl` query for alias.

sara: @mike can you paste the alias output? I want to see pinned variant + fallback policy.

mike: pasted output:

```
$ routingctl get-alias client-xyz --json
{"alias":"client-xyz","pinned_variant":"v2026-instruct","fallback_policy":["region-fallback","compatible-variant"]}
```

mike: but the variant metadata for v2026-instruct lists capabilities: ["embeddings","instruct-gen"]. The runtime mapping shows v2026-instruct registered only on gen-capable pools in eu-west-1, not on embed-optimized nodes.

anjali: that explains why router tried fallback: request came for embeddings and could not find embed-optimized instance for that pinned variant, so it routed to a compatible-variant which ended up being a chat/gen runtime. output format mismatch.

sebastian: confirmed in logs: fallback path -> model v2026-chat-lite on pool gen-eu-1. payloads returned textual generations where embeddings expected. sample trace: trace_id 0a3f...

infra-bot: autoscaler noticed capacity pressure on embed pools at 2026-04-05T07:12Z; no extra nodes added because reserved capacity flagged.

sara: mitigation options: A) unpin alias (remove pinned_variant) to allow correct variant selection, B) temporarily add embed-compatible variant to alias, C) block embeddings requests to this alias while we patch.

jordan: quickest low-risk = remove pin for client-xyz and force a canary pin to embed variant after we confirm. how to unpin:

```
$ routingctl update-alias client-xyz --remove-pinned-variant
# or
$ routingctl set-alias client-xyz --pinned_variant ""
```

mike: I'm going to remove the pin and monitor. will push now. will annotate in audit log.

sara: do it, mike. @customer-ops craft a short message to affected customers explaining a transient routing issue and we're rolling mitigation.

customer-ops: on it. draft: "We're investigating inconsistent embedding responses for some requests; we've applied a routing fix and will follow up with details and RCA." sending to affected tenants now.

mike: patch applied at 2468101301. command output:

```
OK: alias client-xyz updated: pinned_variant cleared
Audit: user=mike action=update-alias alias=client-xyz ts=2468101301
```

mike: metrics update: 5xx rate on embeddings dropping, content-type normalized for retried requests. watching.

anjali: confirming routing now chooses embed-optimized variant v2026-embed-quant where available.

sebastian: no additional customer errors in last 5m; summary from logs: ~420 affected requests max, peak at 07:13Z, ~3 enterprise tenants saw malformed responses.

sara: good. next steps: 1) keep watch for 30m 2) create post-incident task to fix config validation so pinned variants must advertise capability compatibility with the API type (embeddings/gen/chat) 3) add routingctl preflight check to block unintentional pins that cause cross-capability fallbacks.

jordan: will open task: INF-PR-328 with owners = eng-runtime + eng-platform. I'll add reproduction steps and logs.

mike: also recommend adding a hotfix: when fallback would route to incompatible capability, prefer failing fast rather than silently returning wrong payload. that reduces silent customer impact.

sara: agreed. escalate to product for messaging. customers already notified.

sebastian: creating incident summary for postmortem: includes traces, audit events, and customer's sample payloads. assigning follow-up to Anjali + Jordan.

anjali: assigning, will run an eval to ensure alias pin validation and update the model catalog capabilities metadata.

infra-bot: autoscaler: embed pool autoscale re-enabled at 2468101500 after manual override; capacity stable.

sara: last check: affected tenants have acknowledged the update and errors stopped. closing page in 20m unless new signals.

customer-ops: customers responded: appreciate quick response; want RCAs and timeline. I'll coordinate.

incident-bot: Incident P0 acknowledged resolved -> monitoring. Postmortem owner: anjali. Links: /incidents/2468101234/notes

sara: thanks all. quick retro note: add a runbook step for pin-removal and comms template. :white_check_mark:
